17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 2230-32 North Wayne Avenue

Proposed Zoning: RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: Approximately 8,938.8 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is seeking to establish a uniform zoning district, remove the
existing single family home and detached garage at 2232 North Wayne
Avenue, maintain the existing single family home and detached garage at
2230 North Wayne Avenue, and construct a one-story addition, that will
contain an ADU, to the existing detached garage at 2230 North Wayne
Avenue. The existing principal single family home at 2230 North Wayne
Avenue will remain without change and the proposed addition to the
existing detached garage will contain approximately 605 sq. ft. of total floor
area and measure approximately 16 ft.-4 in. tall. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-
0300 optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to
Sec. 17-13-1101-B, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the front setback to
12 ft. and the Applicant is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as
allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) | The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 7,646 square feet (0.86 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 4,469.4 square feet
(2 residential units proposed)

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 4 parking spaces

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 12 feet (existing)
b. Side Setbacks:
North Side: 26 feet- 6 inches (proposed)
South Side: 2 feet-5 inches (existing)
c. Rear Setback: 41 feet (existing)

(E) Building Height: 42 feet-6 inches (existing)
